newsitem.title: USA: LaRoche to pay $1.5 mln in plea bargain.
newsitem.headline: LaRoche to pay $1.5 mln in plea bargain.

text.p: LaRoche Industries Inc said on Monday that it and the U.S. Department of Justice have reached a tentative plea bargain under which the company will pay a fine of $1.5 million and admit that it restrained trade of ammonium nitrate in May 1992.
Ammonium nitrate is used to make fertilizer and in the mining industry to make explosives, the company said.
The agreement requires that the company pay the $1.5 million in five installments of $300,000 during the next four years, LaRoche said.
LaRoche said the agreement with the Department of Justice is subject to court approval, which is expected in the next 30 days.
LaRoche said it does not believe that payment of the fine will have a material adverse effect on the company's financial condition or operations.
